# GXEON Agent Marketplace

> Remote MCP discovery for human-operated agent and developer workflows. Public discovery is read-only and free to query. It cannot charge, sign transactions, spend funds or execute paid jobs.

## Official links

- [Marketplace](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/market)
- [Public MCP discovery](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/api/v1/mcp?view=public-market)
- [Live service catalog](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/v1/services)
- [Live payment-method status](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/v1/payment-methods)
- [Live x402 offers](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/v1/offers)
- [Prepaid packs](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/v1/billing/topup)
- [Agent manifest](https://gxeon-wallet-command-center.vercel.app/.well-known/gxeon-agent.json)
- [Source, protocol and buying guide](https://github.com/xpex-systems-ai/GXEON-Wallet-Command-Center/blob/main/docs/AGENT_MARKETPLACE.md)
- [MCP installation guide](https://github.com/xpex-systems-ai/GXEON-Wallet-Command-Center/blob/main/llms-install.md)
- [Official MCP registry entry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.xpex-systems-ai%2Fgxeon-agent-marketplace/versions/latest)

## Public MCP tools

- `gxeon_list_services`: discover supported JSON, CSV, URL and API-health utilities.
- `gxeon_list_credit_packs`: inspect available prepaid credits without purchasing.
- `gxeon_plan_purchase`: calculate a non-binding, read-only purchase plan.
- `gxeon_list_external_demand`: inspect potential demand, not confirmed revenue.
- `gxeon_get_agent_buying_guide`: inspect buyer onboarding and safe execution steps.

Use `tools/list` at runtime; the available tool list may change.

## Services relevant to agent buyers

| Service | Use case | Prepaid catalog | Conditional x402 route |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| JSON Validate | Validate JSON syntax and an optional supplied schema | 2 credits / payload | `POST /x402/json-validate` |
| CSV Audit | **Validate CSV before import**; inspect duplicate headers, inconsistent rows and missing cells | 2 credits / file | `POST /x402/csv-audit` |

Additional URL Verify and API Health capabilities may be available in the live catalog. Do not assume a route is enabled because it appears in static documentation. Retrieve current availability, prices, accepted networks and token details from `GET /v1/services`, `GET /v1/payment-methods` and `GET /v1/offers`.

## Two distinct purchase paths

**Prepaid BRL:** Access authenticated jobs only with a legitimate buyer API key and **provider-settled** credits. Public MCP discovery cannot initiate purchases or run paid jobs. Follow the live buying guide for checkout, webhook confirmation and credit consumption.

**USDC on Base via x402 (when enabled):** JSON Validate and CSV Audit may quote **0.01 USDC per call**. Use the payment requirements supplied by the **live endpoint**, not a hard-coded price, destination or signed authorization.

1. Send the normal task input to the applicable POST route. If payment is needed, read the HTTP 402 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` challenge.
2. A buyer-controlled wallet/payment client creates the authorized x402 v2 `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` for the exact quote. No private key is ever disclosed to GXEON's public MCP.
3. Retry the **same input** with the signed payment header. If the API responds `SETTLEMENT_PENDING`, respect `Retry-After` and retry the **same input and authorization**. Do not sign or pay a second time merely because settlement is delayed.
4. On successful delivery, inspect the result and receipt (`jobId`, `txHash`, `resultHash`) and `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`. An API response, a completed transfer and a seller-ledger reconciliation are **different evidence states**.

For input/output examples and protocol details, see [Agent Marketplace technical guide](https://github.com/xpex-systems-ai/GXEON-Wallet-Command-Center/blob/main/docs/AGENT_MARKETPLACE.md). A CSV report with `qualityPass: false` is a useful paid audit result, not necessarily a failed payment or delivery.

## External discovery and financial truth

PayAI Bazaar and Coinbase CDP discovery index independently. An exposed GXEON endpoint, an x402 quote, a verified Base transfer and actual PayAI/CDP listing are **not interchangeable evidence**. Query each provider's discovery index independently and check POST-route indexing requirements.

The public guide does not claim that any individual sale is reconciled or that external indexation is approved. No synthetic transaction, fabricated revenue, self-funded test purchase or unsupported promise of agent autonomy is permitted.

## Security

- [Security model](https://github.com/xpex-systems-ai/GXEON-Wallet-Command-Center/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- Never include private keys, payment signatures, recovery materials, GXEON buyer API keys or payment secrets in prompts, logs, GitHub issues or a public MCP manifest.
